document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
after: You do NOT need to write any addresses.

text: I am writing in response to the article ‘Young People Turn Their Backs on Their Town’, which appeared in your newspaper on 12 May.

The article claimed that very few young people in Ashbury take part in volunteer work and that most of them are only interested in their phones. In my view, this is both unfair and inaccurate, and I believe it gives readers a misleading picture of our town.

As the organiser of the Ashbury Youth Volunteers, I work with over sixty teenagers who give up their weekends to help the community. Last year alone, they cleaned the riverbank, collected food for the local food bank and visited elderly residents every Sunday afternoon.

I would therefore like to invite one of your reporters to join us at our next event on 3 June, so that your readers can see the other side of the story. I believe a follow-up article would be welcomed by many families in the area.
I hope you will consider this invitation, and I look forward to your reply.

note.en: Two faults of the article in one pair.
note.ru: Два недостатка статьи в одной паре.

note.en: Introduces the writer and why they can be trusted.
note.kk: Жазушыны таныстырады — оған неге сенуге болады.
note.ru: Представляет пишущего — почему ему можно верить.

note.en: Moves from evidence to the suggestion.

strengths.en: “In my view … unfair and inaccurate” is firm but correct, with no attack on the journalist.
strengths.kk: «In my view … unfair and inaccurate» — нақты, бірақ әдепті, журналистке шабуылсыз.
strengths.ru: «In my view … unfair and inaccurate» — твёрдо, но корректно, без нападок на журналиста.
strengths.example: In my view, this is both unfair and inaccurate

strengths.en: The number of volunteers and specific activities are the best reply to an inaccurate article.
strengths.kk: Еріктілер саны және нақты істер — дәл емес мақалаға ең жақсы жауап.
strengths.ru: Число волонтёров и конкретные дела — лучший ответ на неточную статью.
strengths.example: they cleaned the riverbank, collected food for the local food bank

strengths.en: The writer offers the newspaper a way to put things right.
strengths.kk: Жазушы газетке көріністі қалай түзетуге болатынын ұсынады.
strengths.ru: Пишущий предлагает газете, как исправить картину.

title.en: A solution, not just a complaint

strengths.example: invite one of your reporters to join us

strengths.en: No contractions and a standard formal ending.
strengths.kk: Қысқартулар жоқ, formal хаттың стандартты соңы.
strengths.example: I look forward to your reply

note.en: No name is given, so the letter is formal: “Dear Sir or Madam”.
note.kk: Алушының аты жоқ — formal және «Dear Sir or Madam».
note.ru: Имени адресата нет — formal и «Dear Sir or Madam».

note.en: A letter to a newspaper: the article’s title and date come first.
note.kk: Газетке хат: мақаланың атауы мен күні — бірінші сөйлемде.
note.ru: Письмо в газету: название статьи и дата — в первой фразе.

note.en: Bullet 1: what the article claimed, followed at once by the writer’s view — “unfair and inaccurate”.
note.kk: 1-тармақ — мақала не айтты, және бірден автордың ұстанымы: «unfair and inaccurate».
note.ru: Пункт 1 — что утверждала статья, и сразу позиция автора: «unfair and inaccurate».

note.en: Bullet 2: why the writer disagrees — facts from experience, not emotion.
note.kk: 2-тармақ — неге келіспейді: эмоция емес, өз тәжірибесінен фактілер.
note.ru: Пункт 2 — почему не согласен: факты из собственного опыта, а не эмоции.

note.en: Bullet 3: a constructive suggestion — inviting a reporter.
A polite ending that asks for a reply.
“Dear Sir or Madam” is closed with “Yours faithfully” and a full name.
note.kk: «Dear Sir or Madam» хаты «Yours faithfully» және толық атымен аяқталады.
note.ru: «Dear Sir or Madam» закрывается «Yours faithfully» и полным именем.

document.title: Replying to a newspaper article
bullets: explain why you disagree with it
suggest what the newspaper could do
document.question:
